correctness.rationale: From the affine-plane axioms, the deleted incidence graph has distance exactly four within the q deleted-direction point blocks and within each of q retained parallel classes of line vertices; all other distinct pairs have distance at most three. Radius-three graph power is complete 2q-partite with q vertices per class, giving an exact simplicial join. Integral join homology and homotopy establish a wedge of (q-1)^(2q) (2q-1)-spheres. A separate q+1 simplex-size bound at radius two and diameter-four check establish [3,4) top persistence. Exact independent BFS verifies q=2,3,5,7 and complete mod-two boundaries for q=2,3; finite tests are not used as universal proof.
